title: Social Security Benefit Applied as Representative Payee to an Approved-Case Advance
content:
For an advance toward the coming month on an approved Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage case, the benefit the resident's funds account applies as representative payee is read from the Social Security deposits received as payee into the resident's account under Resident Trust Fund Accounts.

**Rule.** The benefit applied as representative payee for an advance: where more than one Social Security benefit was received as payee within the last month, the larger of the latest of them and the others together, so that the month's regular benefit is applied whichever deposit was posted last; where no benefit was received as payee within the last two months, nothing, since the payments have stopped; otherwise the latest benefit received.

| Benefits received as payee within the last month | Within the last two months | Benefit applied |
|---|---|---|
| more than one | (at least those) | the larger of the latest deposit and the other deposits of the month taken together |
| exactly one | at least one | the latest benefit received |
| none | at least one | the latest benefit received |
| none | none | nothing |

Where two deposits share the latest posting date, the one posted first is the latest.

**Hypothetical cases.**

1. Within the last month, a 72.40-dollar adjustment and, posted later, a regular benefit of 1,148.00 dollars: the larger of 1,148.00 and 72.40 is applied — 1,148.00 dollars.
2. Within the last month, deposits of 600.00 and 575.00 dollars (the latter posted last) and of 40.00 dollars: the larger of 575.00 and 640.00 — 640.00 dollars.
3. One deposit of 1,148.00 dollars received six weeks ago and nothing since: 1,148.00 dollars.
4. The last deposit received ten weeks ago: nothing.
